# Loading of data
```{r,include = FALSE}
library(readr)
library(here)
file_path <- here("data", "raw", "diabetic_data.csv")


raw_df <- read_csv(file_path,
                   na = c("?", "NA", ""),
                   show_col_types = FALSE)

```

# Handling of "Not Available" data
```{r}
#percentage of NAs for every column
na_percent <- colMeans(is.na(raw_df)) * 100
sort(na_percent[na_percent > 0], decreasing = TRUE)

```

| Variable          | Missingness | Strategy          | Methodological Rationale |
|:------------------|:------------|:------------------|:--------------------------|
| weight            | >96%        | Column Omission   | Unusable feature; imputation introduces noise. |
| payer_code        | ~40%        | Column Omission   | Administrative billing category, not clinical. |
| medical_specialty | ~49%        | Recode to "Missing" | Informative missingness (proxy for ER admission). |
| race              | ~2%         | Row Omission      | Complete-case filtering; preserves >97% of sample. |
| diag_1, diag_2, diag_3           | <1%         | Row Omission      | Complete-case filtering on essential clinical target. |

# Data inbalance
```{r}
raw_df$readmitted_30d <- ifelse(raw_df$readmitted == "<30", 1L, 0L)
N_readmitted<-sum(raw_df$readmitted_30d)
fraction_readmitted<-mean(raw_df$readmitted_30d, na.rm = TRUE)

```

# Unique patients
```{r}
n_unique_patients <- length(unique(raw_df$patient_nbr))
visit_counts <- table(raw_df$patient_nbr)
visit_distribution <- table(visit_counts)
print(head(visit_distribution, 5))
```
